summary: Tested backend + frontend for Create My Profile latency regression. Profile submit now completes promptly, persists correctly, and navigates to Home. Backend upsert single-round-trip behavior is correct.
action_items: Optional UX polish: consider minimum 200–300ms visibility for saving state so users always perceive feedback on very fast networks.
Optional cleanup: investigate recurring Expo web log warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/profile uses find_one_and_update with projection excluding _id and returns validated response; upsert optimization is correctly implemented.
Onboarding submit uses 6s AbortController timeout and disabled submit button while saving; no indefinite loading observed.
Frontend storage serializes values as JSON; direct raw localStorage reads include quotes and should be JSON-parsed before manual API checks.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ profile records via POST /api/profile and onboarding UI submit during validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI submit-to-home timings observed: ~0.14s and ~0.74s in Expo web preview. Persistence validated by GET /api/profile/{device_id} after JSON-parsing storage device_id.
rca_of_issue: Original user symptom ('Create My Profile is taking too long') appears mitigated by current implementation: pre-warm health call + preloaded device_id + backend one-round-trip upsert. No repro of slow/indefinite submission in this run.
